desc:
Greetings, welcome to the Brazilian Mirage Army.

Here at EB, you will find a wide variety of things to do, such as enlistment, recruitment, TAFs, operations, and much more. You can progress from the rank of Recruit to Commander and beyond.

Here we have:

* Frequent updates
* Constant events
* Operations and much more

Remember to sign up and join the game group.
